feedback: Iteration 0 has no earlier race, so this feedback rests only on what the integration required. The sensor weights [2,1,0,-1,-2] needed no reshaping: at 12 mm spacing the signal stays within about ±2 and kp=4 keeps the turn command in range for moderate errors. The 0.06 m lookahead is the main unknown. If the next race shows high steering_oscillation or max_error near the tape edges, the 0.06 m lookahead is likely too long for the controller's derivative to damp, so reduce it toward 0.04 m. If line_loss_events is high while rms_error is low, the sensor footprint or count is the limit, so widen the sensor span or use 16 mm footprints. If the robot holds the line with low error and oscillation, keep the geometry and move only the track-width and mass fields. In all cases, the Integrator will compare the next race's measurements against this baseline before changing any field.
requested_changes: If steering_oscillation is high in the next race, try sensor_positions y = 0.04 (from 0.06) to shorten lookahead, since the controller's kd damping is limited at speed.
If line_loss_events are above zero with low rms_error, try sensor_size 0.016 with the same x spacing, to widen each sensor's footprint across the 25 mm tape.
If the robot stays on the line with low error, try wheel_track 0.14 (from 0.12) to raise turn authority at base speeds near 1.5 m/s without changing the other fields.
